summary: Implemented controlled backfill for active mentor-workspace linkage fields (`mentor_id`/`provider_id`), wired it into mentor-serving flow, and added nearest-layer coverage including post-backfill validation for `/mentor/centro-comando/alunos`, `/mentor/radar/alunos/{student_id}`, and `/mentor/matriz-renovacao`.
decisions: Added explicit backfill methods in repositories instead of route-level logic to preserve service/repository boundaries.
Limited backfill to active records and empty linkage fields only; existing non-empty assignments are preserved.
Executed backfill from `IndicatorCargaService` before active enrollment selection so mentor endpoints self-heal legacy records.
Added API test scenario that intentionally nulls linkage fields and verifies endpoint parity plus persisted backfill state.
Kept test-only fallback in mentor API helper for environments where indicator-load is Postgres-gated (`409`), without changing production runtime behavior.
risks: Backfill currently runs in read path (`_iter_active_enrollments`), which can add extra storage I/O under heavy traffic.
If both enrollment and organization linkage sources are missing, records remain unscoped by design.
